last_actions: Copied mimae-concept.md from ~/storage/downloads into repo root
Initialized git repo and committed concept doc + agent state
Step 1 implemented: src/{lib,ids,actor,entities,event}.rs + tests/vocab.rs; 8 tests pass, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean
Step 2 implemented: src/log.rs — append-only JSON-lines log, flock single-writer, fsync per append, torn-tail recovery on open; tests/log.rs 7 tests pass, clippy/fmt clean

Step 3: src/graph.rs (strict fold, stream()-based replay, dep-gated readiness, deterministic ready ordering, atomic claim) + src/team.rs (TeamState lifecycle incl. initializing->ready->running) + tests (graph: 8 incl. 50-task 2-thread barrier concurrency stress & from-log replay equality; team: 4) — 27 tests, clippy/fmt clean, commit c41a22b

Step 4: Lease gains ttl_ms; heartbeat extends expires_at_ms by ttl_ms; Coordinator::check_for_expired_leases sweeps by publishing LeaseExpired (no timer thread — driven at query time). Regression tests for InReview expiry, heartbeat TTL extension, sweep idempotence and from-log replay after sweep. 36 tests, clippy/fmt clean.

Step 5: src/adapter.rs — AgentAdapter trait contract (capabilities, start_session, send_turn, interrupt, resume, inject_context, liveness), SessionEvent normalized event types (Ok/Error/ToolUse/ToolResult/Usage/PermissionRequest/TurnComplete/StateChanged) with serde, TransportMode enum (HeadlessJson/LocalHttpServer/SSE/Pty). AdapterCapabilities carries can_interrupt/resume/inject/hooks + declared_capabilities. AgentState now Copy+Default. tests/adapter.rs with scripted impl + roundtrip. 39 incidents tests pass, clippy/fmt clean.

Step 6: OpenCode T3 adapter — OpenCodeAdapter::spawn_local spawns `opencode serve` on a free port, wait_for_health polls with a 3s timeout, start_session POSTs /session, send_turn POSTs /session/:id/message and maps message parts (text/tool/step-finish) into SessionEvent, interrupt via POST .../abort, resume via GET .../session/:id, inject_context via POST .../message with noReply=true. Health checks, ureq requests have per-call timeouts (3s health / 10s resume+inject / 60s turn / 120s server child start). Live test opencode_live_session_semantics verifies contract against a real opencode server when the binary is on PATH (skipped otherwise); capabilites were exercised: start_session returned Started, send_turn returned Vec<SessionEvent> ending TurnComplete, interrupt true + Idle liveness, inject true. 41 tests total, clippy/fmt clean.

Step 8: src/antigravity.rs — AntigravityAdapter implementing AgentAdapter over `agy -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json`, conversation_id captured from events, resume via --conversation, per-turn child kill on Drop. MimoCode added to CliKind. parse_agy_stream_line exposed for pure-parser test. tests/antigravity.rs contract + offline parser + live gated on binary (skipped: agy not on PATH).

Step 9: gate4agent rechecked at v0.4.8 (MIT; 546 commits, 9 stars, 2 forks; rapid 0.4.x releases on 2026-10-02): first-tier Claude Code/Codex/Kimi/Grok, legacy Gemini/OpenCode, qwen removed; no Antigravity/Qwen/Mimo; async/tokio workbench surface mismatches Mimae's sync deterministic core. D3 closed as learn-from/do-not-depend.

Planner loop: src/planner.rs — plan_goal validates empty goal, duplicate/unknown tasks, dependency cycles, overlapping write scopes among parallel tasks (plan-vs-plan and plan-vs-active), shared-interface contract coverage, then publishes GoalSubmitted/TaskCreated/ContractProposed with causal chaining; propose/accept/change_contract + record_decision; next_assignment/assign by capability match; goal_progress with is_complete. TaskGraph now folds contracts (propose/accept/change with version checks). ContractStatus made Copy. tests/planner.rs: 6 tests (happy path, overlap/cycle/missing-contract rejection with zero log side effects, contract loop + replay equality, capability assignment + goal completion + replay equality). 59 tests total, clippy/fmt clean, commit f54b035.
